description: Check ONE company in one call (GET /companies/check): the record (identity, status, industry, officers, owners, group exposure, country risk, change activity), corporate insolvency notices grouped by case or debtor, the company NAME against the sanctions lists, and whether the company can be monitored. Send country and exactly one of company_number, id or name. A name must give ONE company at or above min_score (default 80): several equally good matches are a 409 ambiguous_company_name with the candidates, a weak match a 404 no_match_at_min_score; both are free. checks picks the parts (record always runs; default record,insolvency,sanctions). Every part reports in data.checks[] as run, not_available or not_run with a reason (not_requested, plan, credits_left, natural_person_name, legal_form_unknown, name_not_screenable, error); a read that failed is error with null data, never none or clear. Credits are the parts that ran: record 1, insolvency 2, company-name sanctions screen 3, plus 1 for the name search (6 by number, 7 by name for a full check); a part that did not run is not charged, errors are free. The sanctions part needs the Professional plan or above: on other plans it is not_run with reason plan and the other parts still run and are charged. LIMITS: sanctions screening is beta and a clear result is not a certification (no match found in the lists checked on the date shown); insolvency notices are corporate only, in the markets listed in data.insolvency.markets, and none is not proof of solvency; the company-name screen is not run for a sole proprietorship, nor (legal_form_unknown) where the register's legal form does not show the company is a legal entity: we could not tell it is not a sole trader, so its name was not screened; screen it yourself with sanctions_screen; data.monitoring.reason is country_not_monitored, country_not_in_key or shared_demo_key when not eligible; officers and owners are shown as the register serves them and are NOT screened against the lists in this version (data.sanctions.people is not_available); parents that are legal entities are read from group_exposure (a name match, a prompt to look, not a finding); country_risk is country-level, never a finding about the company. No batch version.

appointments_limit.description: Officers read for the record (1-500, default 100).

checks.description: Comma list of parts: record, insolvency, sanctions, people. record always runs; default record,insolvency,sanctions; people answers not_available in this version.

company_number.description: The register company number. Exactly one of company_number, id, name.

id.description: The numeric company id of company_detail.

min_score.description: With name: the lowest match score (30-100, default 80) that counts as the company.

name.description: A company name; must resolve to one company at or above min_score (+1 credit for the name search).

threshold.description: Minimum match_score the company name must reach on the sanctions screen (30-100, default 80): 100 the same name; 80-99 one holds every word of the other; up to 95 a close spelling; under 80 a word that only begins a longer word. Lower it to 50-60 to catch more spelling variants.

name: company_check
title: Check a company
